It is believed that the battle was a result of Muhammad's expulsion of the Banu Qaynuqa' tribe from Medina.

The name Sahwan is also mentioned in relation to a place where the Prophet Muhammad and his companions sought refuge during their migration from Mecca to Medina in 622 AD. The location is believed to be near the Red Sea, north of Yathrib (later known as Medina). During their journey, they faced several challenges, including a fierce sandstorm that was named Sahwan.
